name: Pets Maker
description: An optional catalog-installed side-rail app for preparing validated Remilia Maker pet-request bundles.

notes: Uses only the public overlay app lifecycle, local assets, diagnostics, and cancellation contract.

settings.label: Pets Maker
settings.description: Enable the optional Remilia pet bundle maker and its side-rail launcher.

notes: Loads on dockOpen and removes all app-owned DOM and listeners on close, disable, abort, or dispose.
Uses the shared X/Twitter App SDK runtime and requests no additional host permission.
After an explicit Fetch click, reads only public NFT metadata for the selected Maker family and number; the app does not mount a UI on the Maker site.
Uses package-owned Remilia pet-lab chrome aligned with the public RemiNet window style and SDK semantic tokens.

hub.shortDescription: Build a local Maker avatar bundle for the Remilia pet pipeline.
hub.longDescription: Choose a Maker family and NFT number, provide the local transparent avatar and exact traits, complete the lower body, preview the deterministic composite, and download a validated bundle.
permissionNotes: The https://maker.remilia.org/* host permission is used only after an explicit Fetch click to read public metadata for the selected family and NFT number.
dataNotes: Reads only the PNG selected in the visible app form and processes it in memory for preview and download.
An explicit Fetch sends only the selected public Maker family and NFT number; returned public traits populate the visible form and are not cached.
remoteServices: The official Maker metadata endpoint is queried only after an explicit Fetch click and returns public NFT traits.
localStorageNotes: Stores only the generated app enablement toggle.

permissionNotes: The https://maker.remilia.org/* host permission is used only after an explicit Fetch click to read public metadata for the selected family and NFT number.
dataNotes: The selected PNG, traits, NFT number, and body choices stay in the open app and generated local ZIP. Nothing is uploaded, posted, published, or cached.
An explicit Fetch sends only the selected public Maker family and NFT number to maker.remilia.org and populates the visible trait fields from its public response.
localStorageNotes: Stores only app enablement; maker form state and selected files are not persisted.

notes: Reviewed optional App SDK package for the maintainer catalog.
Remy icon provenance and VPL compatibility are recorded in AUTHORING_LOG.md.
The package uses no private host imports, background handlers, or page observers; its only remote call is an explicit read of public Maker metadata.
